from tslearn.metrics import lcss_path_from_metric

path, sim = lcss_path_from_metric(s1, s2, eps=0.5, metric="euclidean")

assert isinstance(path, list), "Path must be a list of index pairs"
assert isinstance(sim, float), "Similarity must be a float"

# The similarity is computed as the percentage of the LCSS length regarding the length of the shortest time series
expected_sim = len(path) / min(len(s1), len(s2))
assert abs(sim - expected_sim) < 1e-7, f"Expected similarity {expected_sim}, got {sim}"
assert len(path) <= min(len(s1), len(s2)), "LCSS path length cannot exceed the shortest series length"

print(f"__CHECK__ lcss_path_from_metric {len(path)}_{sim:.4f}")
